rationale: auto-harness (neosigmaai/auto-harness per README.md git URL) is a self-improving LLM-agent benchmark harness, not a scraping tool. Core loop (program_templates/base.md, README.md): run benchmark -> analyze failures -> improve agent/agent.py -> gate -> record -> repeat, on three benchmarks (tau-bench, Terminal-Bench 2.0, BIRD-Interact). 13 Python files / 2910 LOC / 6 dirs. The transferable piece for the self-healing concern is the regression gate in gating.py (lines 223-308): Step 0 file-edit guard, Step 1 regression suite pass rate >= threshold, Step 2 full test val_score >= best seen, Step 3 promotion of newly-fixed tasks into the suite (workspace/suite.json, persisted via save_suite). This is exactly the pattern a self-healing extraction pipeline needs (maintain a suite of known-good targets, reject changes that regress them, promote newly-fixed targets), but it is a generic benchmark-reward gate, not selector healing: there is no DOM, CSS/XPath selector, or browser-automation code anywhere (grep for selector/scrap/crawl/browser/json-ld/schema.org in source found only an unrelated _extract_text_from_content helper in agent/helpers/bird_interact/bird_adk_runtime.py). Heritage=false and heritageBasis=none because this is not a declared core candidate and source evidence does not establish a direct implementation fit for any of the 8 pipeline concerns - the self-healing fit is pattern-level/analogical only. Tier C: real architectural depth (abstract BenchmarkRunner ABC + 3 concrete runners in benchmark.py lines 29-795, config-driven prepare.py baseline/split generation lines 282-339, deterministic gating) and moderate size, but relevance to a scraping pipeline that extracts laptop specs is tangential since no scraping-domain code exists. hasArchitectureDocs=false: only a 6-bullet README 'Design' section (README.md lines 281-289), no docs/ or dedicated architecture file. hasTests=false: no tests/ directory or test files; grep for pytest/unittest/def test found none.
limitations: Domain is LLM-agent benchmark optimization (tau-bench, Terminal-Bench, BIRD-Interact); no web-scraping, DOM, selector, or browser-automation code exists in the source tree.
Relevance to the self-healing concern is analogical: the regression-suite + promotion gate (gating.py) is a transferable pattern, not an implementation of self-healing selectors for a scraper.
No test suite in the repo; hasTests=false verified by filesystem and grep.
No dedicated architecture/design docs; only a short README 'Design' section, so hasArchitectureDocs=false.
Gate logic assumes a benchmark reward metric per task; reusing it for a scraper requires redefining pass/fail criteria and a verifier per target.
Runs only against external benchmark infrastructure (tau2 git dep pinned in pyproject.toml, harbor CLI, BIRD-Interact-ADK, E2B/Daytona/Modal sandboxes); not self-contained for scraping use.
README claims of score improvement (0.56 -> 0.78) are from a linked blog, not verifiable from the source.
